title: transfinite-dreaming
description: Morphism: memory -> new-predicate claims. The TRANSFINITE-BOUNDED dream (omega < kappa < omega_1): derives NEW PREDICATES (new dimensions of relation) from co-occurrence -- subjects sharing a (predicate,value) become related by a derived co-<predicate>. Grows the relational vocabulary (so closure is transfinite), but bounded below omega_1 and INTERNAL (the new predicates are derived, not channeled -- which keeps it below the aperiodic regime).
